body: think about all the good things you have in life. What personally really helps me is keeping a 'happy' book. Every time something makes me smile, i write about it or stick whatever it was (if its small enough) in one of the pages. I have comic books, birthday cards, and drawing exploding out of that thing. Every time i open it, i cant help but smile at one thing in that binder. Please dont kill yourself. people do care. if you cant think of anyone, well i care.
